title: The optimal complexity of Klee's measure problem in higher dimensions
formal: For each fixed dimension d≥3, what is the optimal worst-case time to compute the volume of the union of n axis-aligned boxes in Rᵈ?
context:
The dimension is fixed; specify the real-RAM model for the geometric running-time target. Variable-dimensional hardness is a different question.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
